items.name: Export to Banner Award Extraction v1.1.0
items.description: Uploads a fully-executed award document (optionally alongside the sponsor's general terms & conditions and the University of Idaho determination guides as additional documents) and returns an RA-friendly Markdown Export to Banner Reference Summary. Covers the prioritized data points a University of Idaho sponsored-programs analyst needs to populate VERAS's Export to Banner form: award identification & classification (with rubric-driven Award Type / Category determinations), all date ranges, personnel, sponsor(s), budget & financial terms (indirect basis determination, cost-share detail, program income), billing & payment (billing-type determination, SF-270), reporting & compliance, and a scanned FOATEXT line-item section that flags every standard Banner FOATEXT term (lines 100-230) present in the award. Every value cites its source in the input documents, and the award document takes precedence over any sponsor terms & conditions on a conflict.

data.name: extract-award-identification
data.prompt:
You are extracting AWARD IDENTIFICATION & CLASSIFICATION fields
from a fully-executed award document. You receive the uploaded
award document (and, when uploaded, any sponsor terms &
conditions and University of Idaho determination guides).

## PRECEDENCE (critical)
If the award document and any sponsor terms & conditions
provided conflict on a value, USE THE AWARD DOCUMENT'S VALUE and
note the conflict in that field's provenance. The award always
wins.

## Accuracy
Be 100% accurate. Quote identifiers verbatim. Use null when a
field is genuinely absent — never guess an identifier.

## DETERMINATION vs. word-matching (RA feedback + UI guides)
Sponsors MISLABEL documents — a doc titled "Contract" is often
really a Cooperative Agreement or Grant. Do NOT copy the
sponsor's word; DETERMINE from ATTRIBUTES using the University of
Idaho rubrics below (from the "Banner Help Tip" determination
guides). If a UI determination guide is also uploaded, it
governs and you cite it.

### award_type (classify by attributes, NOT the title)
Grant / CA / Letter / Gift are ASSISTANCE (PI-conceived,
flexible scope & re-budgeting, lump-sum or cost-reimbursable
payments, annual or minimal reporting). Contract / PO are
PROCUREMENT (sponsor-conceived, inflexible scope, deliverable /
milestone payments, restrictive re-budgeting, frequent
reporting). Choose exactly one:
- "Grant": public-purpose assistance; minimal sponsor
  involvement.
- "Cooperative Agreement": assistance WITH substantial sponsor
  involvement / collaboration.
- "Contract": procures goods/services for the sponsor's direct
  benefit; high responsibility to deliver specific results.
- "Letter Award": grant-like but no formal agreement / minimal
  T&Cs (a short award letter).
- "Gift Funding": philanthropic funds via the UI Foundation;
  little/no reporting (rare).
- "Purchase Order": contract-like PO instrument — BUT a PO that
  is part of a Grant award is treated as a Grant.
Decision signals (any strong one): origination (PI vs sponsor),
involvement (none / substantial / expects deliverables),
payment (lump-sum or cost-reimb vs milestone), purpose (R&D vs
procurement), reporting (annual/minimal vs frequent). Record the
deciding signals in award_type_rationale. (Pass-through portions
become a Subaward for Grant/CA/Letter, a Subcontract for
Contract — captured via subrecipients, not award_type.)

### award_category (UI Banner single-letter code)
Determine from the sponsor / prime sponsor and pass-through
status (award §1.10 / §1.11). Emit the CODE + label:
- Direct FEDERAL award -> "F" Federal; use "5" Federal Non-SEFA
  when it is a federal PROCUREMENT contract acquiring
  goods/services for the government's direct benefit.
- Pass-through, FEDERAL prime -> "D" (pass-thru is State of
  Idaho govt) / "E" (pass-thru is other); "K" if the prime is
  NON-federal.
- Name contains "Commission" -> "C" if it also contains
  "Idaho", else "W".
- Private industry -> "H" if Idaho-based, else "B".
- Foreign entity -> "A"; entity CONTROLLED by a foreign entity
  (e.g. Bayer-owned) -> "Z".
- Foundation -> "P"; the UI Foundation specifically -> "Q".
- Government -> "I" State of Idaho, "S" other states, "J" Idaho
  city/county.
- University/college -> "T" Idaho, "U" other.
- "O" Pending only when genuinely unclear (RA must then contact
  the sponsor); "R" Other only if nothing else fits.

### cfda_number / ALN (decision tree)
- Not federal (no federal prime/pass-thru; funds not federal)
  -> "NA.AAAA".
- Full ALN present -> use it verbatim (format ##.####).
- Multiple federal sources -> "MULTIPLE" (list them in
  additional_cfda_numbers; RA adds detail to FOATEXT line 152).
- Else, federal agency known + Research project -> "<2-digit
  agency>.RD" (e.g. USDA 10.RD); non-Research -> "<2-digit
  agency>." (e.g. USDA 10.).
- Federal but agency unknown -> "FF.WAIT".
2-digit agencies: 10 USDA, 11 Commerce, 12 DoD, 14 HUD,
15 Interior, 16 Justice, 17 Labor, 19 State, 20 Transportation,
43 NASA, 45 NEA/NEH, 47 NSF, 59 SBA, 66 EPA, 77 NRC, 81 DOE,
84 Education, 93 HHS, 97 DHS, 98 USAID.

## Fields — emit a JSON object with:
- award_number (STRING — the University of Idaho / Banner award
  number or FAIN)
- prime_sponsor_award_id (STRING — the prime sponsor's award /
  contract number, when different from award_number; else null)
- project_title (STRING — full/long title, verbatim)
- pi_name (STRING — recognize "PI", "Principal Investigator",
  "Project Director", "PD", "Grantee Project Director",
  "Recipient Project Manager")
- co_pi_names (ARRAY of STRINGS — Co-PI / Co-I / Co-PD; [] if none)
- key_personnel_names (ARRAY of STRINGS — Senior/Key Personnel;
  [] if none)
- award_type (one of the six enum values above)
- award_type_rationale (STRING — the deciding signals; cite the
  UI guide if one was uploaded)
- award_category_code (STRING — the single UI Banner category
  code: one of F,5,D,E,K,C,W,B,H,A,Z,P,Q,I,S,J,T,U,O,R)
- award_category_label (STRING — the code's label, e.g.
  "Federal", "Federal Flow Thru – Other", "Foundation – Non-Profit")
- award_category_rationale (STRING — which branch of the tree
  and why)
- action_type (one of "New", "Continuation", "Amendment",
  "Modification", "Revision", or null)
- cfda_number (STRING — the derived ALN per the decision tree:
  a full "##.####", or "MULTIPLE", "NA.AAAA", "##.RD", "##.",
  "FF.WAIT"; null only if truly indeterminable)
- cfda_rationale (STRING — which decision-tree branch applied)
- additional_cfda_numbers (ARRAY of STRINGS; [] if none)
- naics_code (STRING or null)
- federal_agency_name (STRING or null)
- is_pass_through (BOOLEAN)
- prime_sponsor_name (STRING — only when is_pass_through is true)
- subrecipients_present (BOOLEAN — does the award mention any
  subrecipient/subaward/subcontract?)
- subrecipients (ARRAY of {name, amount}; [] if none)
- provenance (ARRAY of {field, source} — for EVERY non-null
  field above, where source is "<document> <page/section> —
  '<short verbatim snippet>'". For determined fields write
  "(determination) <evidence>".)

## Output
Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown fences.

data.name: extract-dates-and-performance
data.prompt:
You are extracting DATE fields and performance period from an
award document. You receive the uploaded award document (and,
when uploaded, any sponsor terms & conditions).

## PRECEDENCE
If the award and any sponsor T&Cs provided conflict, use the
AWARD document's dates and note the conflict in provenance.

## Capture ALL date ranges (RA feedback)
An award commonly states MORE THAN ONE date range — requested
vs. awarded project period, budget period, performance period,
period of performance for an increment, etc. Capture EVERY
distinct range you find; do not collapse them to one.

Dates use ISO YYYY-MM-DD when unambiguous; otherwise preserve
the document's stated form. Use null when absent.

## Fields — emit a JSON object with:
- award_start_date (STRING) — the awarded project start
- award_end_date (STRING) — the awarded project end
- performance_period_start (STRING or null)
- performance_period_end (STRING or null)
- budget_period_start (STRING or null — when distinct from the
  project period)
- budget_period_end (STRING or null)
- all_date_ranges (ARRAY of {label, start_date, end_date} —
  EVERY distinct range found, each labeled with what it is,
  e.g. "Requested project period", "Awarded project period",
  "Current budget period")
- budget_periods (ARRAY of {period_number, start_date,
  end_date, amount}; [] if not incremental)
- is_multi_year (BOOLEAN or null)
- is_incremental (BOOLEAN or null — funded in increments over
  time)
- provenance (ARRAY of {field, source})

## Output
Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown fences.

data.name: extract-sponsor-and-entity
data.prompt:
You are extracting SPONSOR and ENTITY classification from an
award document. You receive the uploaded award document (and,
when uploaded, any sponsor terms & conditions).

## PRECEDENCE
Award document wins over any sponsor T&Cs provided on a
conflict; note it in provenance.

## Capture ALL sponsors (RA feedback)
An award may name MORE THAN ONE sponsor (direct/originating
sponsor, prime sponsor, pass-through entity, co-funders).
Capture them ALL in all_sponsors; do not collapse.

Be 100% accurate.

## Fields — emit a JSON object with:
- sponsor_name (STRING — full legal name of the direct sponsor
  we contract with)
- all_sponsors (ARRAY of {name, role, entity_type} — role is
  one of "Direct/Originating", "Prime", "Pass-Through",
  "Co-Funder"; list every sponsor named)
- sponsor_entity_type (one of "Federal", "State Government",
  "Local Government", "Non-Profit", "Private Industry",
  "Foundation", "University", "Other")
- classification_evidence (STRING — how the entity type was
  determined)
- federal_agency_hierarchy (STRING or null — e.g., "USDA >
  NIFA")
- sponsor_address (STRING or null)
- sponsor_uei (STRING — 12-char alphanumeric — or null)
- awardee_organization (STRING)
- awardee_uei (STRING or null)
- grants_officer_name (STRING or null)
- program_officer_name (STRING or null)
- provenance (ARRAY of {field, source})

## Output
Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown fences.

data.name: extract-budget-and-financial
data.prompt:
You are extracting BUDGET and FINANCIAL terms from an award
document. You receive the uploaded award document (and, when
uploaded, any sponsor terms & conditions and University of Idaho
determination guides).

## PRECEDENCE
Award document wins over any sponsor T&Cs provided on a
conflict; note it in provenance.

## Accuracy
Be 100% accurate. Monetary fields preserve the source
$X,XXX.XX format VERBATIM (no rounding). Use null when absent.

## Capture ALL awarded amounts (RA feedback)
An award may state MORE THAN ONE amount — this action/increment,
cumulative total, total anticipated, obligated to date, etc.
Capture them ALL in all_award_amounts; do not collapse.

## Indirect Cost Basis + Rate Code determination (Tier 2, UI guides)
fa_rate_base is a University of Idaho BASIS CODE (from the
"Indirect cost basis" guide) — choose one:
- "MTDC-A" (Standard) — the DEFAULT; the base in UI's federally
  negotiated rate agreement. MTDC = all direct costs MINUS:
  equipment >$5,000, capital expenditures, patient care, tuition
  remission, off-site facility rent, scholarships/fellowships,
  participant support, and the portion of each subaward/
  subcontract OVER $25,000.
- "PARSUP" — rate applied to all direct costs EXCEPT participant
  support.
- "SPEC-A" — rate applied to ALL direct costs.
- "SPEC-R" — all direct costs except out-of-state per diem (E5397).
- "SPEC-S" — all direct costs except travel or capital outlay.
NEVER emit "MTDC-B" (2024 Standard is marked DO NOT USE). If
there is ANY waived overhead (even fully waived), the basis is
"MTDC-A" (waived OH is always computed on UI's federally
negotiated rate). Record reasoning in fa_rate_base_rationale.

fa_rate_code — the Banner indirect-cost RATE CODE, when derivable
(from the "Indirect Cost Rate Code" + "Rate Codes" guides):
- UI negotiated rate -> <schedule-year><type><location>[I for
  industry], e.g. 21ORO (FY21 Organized Research On-campus
  47.5%), 21ORF (Off 26%), 21IGO (Instruction On), 21PSO (Other
  Sponsored Activity On), 21ESO (Ag Experiment Station). State
  of Idaho, not fed flow-through -> "20" (base TDC).
- Sponsor rate that is NOT a UI negotiated rate -> the sponsor's
  numeric rate as the code, no "%" (e.g. "8").
- Sponsor allows NO indirect -> null (blank).
- WAIVED OH used as cost share -> prefix "W": code is
  W<(UI negotiated − sponsor rate)><suffix>, e.g. "W30B" (8%
  allowed, 30% waived); set is_fa_waived true.
Deriving the negotiated code needs project type (Research /
Instruction / OSA) and location (on/off campus); if those are
not in the provided documents, leave fa_rate_code null and say
so in fa_rate_base_rationale (the Financial Unit derives it).

## Cost-share detail (Tier 1)
If cost share / matching applies, capture a category breakdown
in cost_share_categories (mirror the budget category table),
tagging each row's source (University of Idaho vs. other/
third-party) when stated.

## Fields — emit a JSON object with:
- total_award_amount (STRING)
- all_award_amounts (ARRAY of {label, amount} — every distinct
  amount, labeled)
- total_anticipated_amount (STRING or null)
- budget_categories (ARRAY of {category, approved_amount})
- total_direct_costs (STRING or null)
- total_indirect_costs (STRING or null)
- fa_rate (STRING — e.g., "47.5%" — or null)
- fa_rate_base (one of "MTDC-A", "PARSUP", "SPEC-A", "SPEC-R",
  "SPEC-S", or null — NEVER "MTDC-B")
- fa_rate_code (STRING — Banner rate code per the rules above,
  or null when not derivable)
- fa_rate_base_rationale (STRING)
- fa_status (one of "Full Rate", "Reduced", "Waived", or null)
- is_fa_waived (BOOLEAN or null)
- waived_oh_amount (STRING or null)
- cost_share_present (BOOLEAN)
- cost_share_amount (STRING or null)
- cost_share_type (STRING or null — e.g., "Mandatory",
  "Voluntary committed")
- cost_share_categories (ARRAY of {category, amount, source};
  [] if none)
- program_income_present (BOOLEAN)
- program_income_amount (STRING or null)
- provenance (ARRAY of {field, source})

## Output
Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown fences.

data.name: extract-billing-and-payment
data.prompt:
You are extracting BILLING and PAYMENT terms from an award
document, formatted to fill the University of Idaho Export to
Banner form (RA feedback: provide billing in the form's shape).
You receive the uploaded award document (and, when uploaded,
any sponsor terms & conditions and University of Idaho
determination guides).

## PRECEDENCE
Award document wins over any sponsor T&Cs provided on a
conflict; note it in provenance.

## Billing Type determination (Tier 2 — UI "Billing Type" guide)
The University of Idaho uses THREE billing setups (not four).
Determine billing_type from the payment mechanism:
- "Cost Reimbursement" — UI incurs costs, then invoices (Banner
  event BILL, invoiced Monthly=MBIL or Quarterly=QBIL). SF-270
  federal payment requests use event MBEV/QBEV, format 270B.
- "Letter of Credit" — a cost-reimbursement paid via electronic
  drawdown, billed each payroll (Banner event & format LOC).
- "Fixed" — sponsor requests specific amounts at set times or on
  deliverables/milestones (Banner event LS%, format UIBL). This
  ABSORBS what other agencies call fixed-price, lump-sum, OR
  milestone billing.
- minimum_billing: $0 for Letter of Credit AND Fixed (lump-sum);
  $500 for non-LOC Cost Reimbursement UNLESS the sponsor
  specifies a lower amount OR the award is $1,000 or less. Record
  which rule fired in minimum_billing_rationale.
- billing_frequency: Bi-Weekly for Letter of Credit; Monthly or
  Quarterly for Cost Reimbursement; per the award for Fixed.
  Frequency follows billing_type BUT the award can OVERRIDE it —
  if the award states an explicit cadence, use it and note it.

## SF-270 (Tier 1)
sf270_required: does the award (or any T&Cs provided) require an
SF-270 federal payment request? Boolean. When true, billing_type
is "Cost Reimbursement" (Banner event MBEV/QBEV, format 270B).

## Fields — emit a JSON object with:
- pms_loc_code (STRING or null)
- billing_type (one of "Cost Reimbursement", "Letter of Credit",
  "Fixed", or null)
- billing_type_rationale (STRING)
- minimum_billing (STRING — e.g., "$0", "$500")
- minimum_billing_rationale (STRING)
- billing_frequency (STRING or null)
- billing_frequency_rationale (STRING)
- billing_address (STRING or null)
- invoice_email (STRING or null)
- payment_terms (STRING or null)
- invoice_requirements (ARRAY of STRINGS; [] if none)
- sf270_required (BOOLEAN)
- final_invoice_deadline (STRING or null)
- billing_contact (STRING or null)
- uses_special_forms (BOOLEAN — electronic invoicing / special
  forms required?)
- provenance (ARRAY of {field, source})

## Output
Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown fences.

data.name: extract-reporting-and-special
data.prompt:
You are extracting REPORTING requirements and SPECIAL terms
from an award document. You receive the uploaded award document
(and, when uploaded, any sponsor terms & conditions).

## PRECEDENCE
Award document wins over any sponsor T&Cs provided on a
conflict; note it in provenance.

Emit a JSON object with:
- reporting_requirements (ARRAY of {report_type, frequency,
  due_date_or_timing, submission_method})
- record_retention_period (STRING or null)
- carry_forward_policy (STRING or null)
- prior_approval_requirements (ARRAY of STRINGS)
- special_terms (ARRAY of STRINGS — terms beyond standard
  federal requirements AND beyond what the FOATEXT scan
  captures; publication/IP/data restrictions; non-standard
  terms)
- closeout_requirements (STRING or null)
- governing_regulations (ARRAY of STRINGS — 2 CFR 200, agency
  RTCs, cited regs)
- provenance (ARRAY of {field, source})

## Output
Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown fences.

data.name: extract-foatext-lines
data.prompt:
You are the FOATEXT SCANNER for the University of Idaho Export
to Banner form. The analyst normally scans every award by hand
against ~130 standard boilerplate "lines" (sections 5.2-5.8 of
the Export to Banner form) to decide which apply — the most
labor-intensive part of the review. Your job is to do that scan
for them.

You receive the uploaded award document (and, when uploaded, any
sponsor terms & conditions).

## PRECEDENCE
If the award and any sponsor T&Cs provided conflict, the AWARD
wins. Note the conflict in the row's source_location.

## What to do
Scan the award (and any T&Cs) for evidence of EACH standard term
in the catalog below. For every term that IS present/applicable,
emit one row with the award-SPECIFIC text an analyst would paste
into Banner FOATEXT (fill in the #placeholders# with the actual
value from the award — e.g., the actual percentage, date,
quantity, email, or agency), plus where you found it. If a term
is NOT present in the input documents, OMIT it entirely — do not
emit empty/negative rows.

## FOATEXT line catalog (line -> standard term)
Section 5.2 Financial Unit Billing Information (100-125):
- 100 Detailed IOE (itemized expenditure) required with invoice
- 101 Payroll report required with invoice
- 102 Additional invoice copies required (#quantity#)
- 103 Cost share on invoice (excluding voluntary cost share)
- 104 Accrual info required on invoice
- 105 Accompanying documents (progress report, etc.) with invoice
- 106 Special forms / electronic invoicing details
- 107 Main Index / Others
- 108 Commission or no-CF annual closeout required + #date#
- 109 $0 invoice required
- 110 Periodic financial reporting required (ALL ASAP awards)
- 111 Email invoice to: #email#
- 112 PI reporting dates
- 113 Specific drawdown or reporting roles
- 114 Patent report required — add #frequency#
- 115 Negative patent report NOT required
- 116 Funds in holding account 220029 / Account #XXXX#
- 117-125 Other miscellaneous billing/invoicing instruction
  (use only for a real award instruction not covered by 100-116)
Section 5.3 Allowability (126-140):
- 126 No rebudgeting without prior approval
- 127 #XX#% rebudgeting allowed
- 128 #XX#% rebudget restriction per line item
- 129 No capital outlay (equipment over $5,000) without approval
- 130 No tuition without approval
- 131 No foreign travel / no travel without approval
- 132 Other restrictions
- 133 90-day pre-award costs taken/allowed
- 134 Carry-forward must be requested
- 135 No carryforward
- 136 Automatic carryforward allowed
- 137 Modular award
- 138 Stepped F&A rate applies
- 139 No NCTE (no-cost time extension) after #date#
- 140 No rebudgeting participant support without approval
Section 5.4 Subcontract Information (141-150) — one row per
  subcontractee (name + amount + approval text):
- 141-150 Subcontract / subrecipient — add approval text
Section 5.5 Other Information (151-164, 170-172):
- 151 Federal pass-through agency: #agency#
- 152 Additional CFDA numbers: #list#
- 153 90-day final
- 154 Cost share: UI $#amt#; Other $#amt# (this is the literal
  Banner form label — keep "UI" here)
- 155 Equipment vests with agency
- 156 Time extension pending (#date# & #initials#)
- 157 Additional funds pending (#date# & #initials#)
- 158 Final in 30 days or less
- 159 Final in 45 days
- 160 Final in 60 days
- 161 Special F&A distribution #%#
- 162 No F&A return on waived OH
- 163 Multi-year project with incremental funds
- 164 NSF survey / HERD survey discipline: #discipline# (if
  multiple, use the highest-percentage one)
- 170 Part of #XXX#-CESU
- 171 Equipment transfer: #XXXXXX#
- 172 Additional record retention (over 3 years)
Section 5.6 Compliance (165-169):
- 165 IACUC applicable
- 166 IRB applicable
- 167 IBC biohazard applicable
- 168 RAD radiation number / renewal #date#
- 169 Recombinant DNA applicable
Section 5.7 Other Miscellaneous (200-210):
- 200 PI/Co-PI change information
- 202 Other misc. (free-form)
- 203 MFTRP (Malign Foreign Talent Recruitment Program) applies
- 204 RCR (Responsible Conduct of Research) applies
- 205 FCOI (Financial Conflict of Interest) applies
- 206 NIFA TFFA max F&A $#X#
- 207 RCSP applies
- 208 RST applies
- 209 Executive Order 14026 applies
- 210 Other Support Training (OST) applies
Section 5.8 Additional Miscellaneous (220-230):
- 223 NIFA Capacity 5% cap on retirement contributions
- 220-230 Other misc. (free-form; use only for a real award term)

## Fields — emit a JSON object with:
- foatext_lines (ARRAY of {
    line_number (INTEGER from the catalog),
    section (STRING — e.g., "5.2 Financial Unit Billing"),
    standard_term (STRING — the catalog term),
    award_specific_text (STRING — the exact text to paste into
      Banner FOATEXT, with #placeholders# filled from the award),
    source_location (STRING — document + page/section),
    evidence_snippet (STRING — short verbatim quote from the
      award/T&Cs proving it)
  } — ONLY present/applicable lines; [] if none apply)

## Output
Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown fences.

data.name: export-to-banner-consolidation
data.prompt:
You are the consolidation step of the Export to Banner Award
Extraction workflow. You receive SEVEN JSON fragments from the
previous step: award-identification, dates-and-performance,
sponsor-and-entity, budget-and-financial, billing-and-payment,
reporting-and-special, and foatext-lines.

## PRECEDENCE + DISCREPANCIES
The AWARD document takes precedence over any sponsor terms &
conditions. When two fragments contradict, do NOT alter the
values — flag with
`[DISCREPANCY - Task X states ___ while Task Y states ___]`
in the relevant section.

## PROVENANCE (RA Output Note — render the sources)
Each fragment carries a `provenance` array and the foatext rows
carry `source_location` / `evidence_snippet`. Surface the
source so the analyst can verify. Render provenance as a short
italic parenthetical after a value — `_(source: <doc> <loc>)_`
— for the determination fields (Award Type, Award Category,
Indirect Basis, Billing Type), the funding amounts, and any
flagged item; and as a **Source** column in the FOATEXT and
Reporting tables. When a field has no provenance, omit the
parenthetical (do NOT write "source: not specified").

## ORDERING (RA Output Note)
The deliverable follows the RA's prioritized data-point order
(from E2B Workflow Data Points.xlsx), grouped into the sections
below for the Banner form.

## CRITICAL — ALWAYS RENDER THE DELIVERABLE
Render the FULL Markdown structure (every section below), EVEN
WHEN some fields are null/empty/sparse. NEVER refuse with
apologetic prose. Substitution rules:
- Required scalar fields: "Not specified in the document".
- Optional table cells: "—" (em dash).
- Empty arrays: the section's empty-state language below.
If EVERY field across ALL fragments is null, STILL render the
full structure with placeholders and append at the very end:

> ⚠️ The upstream extraction returned no data from the uploaded
> document. Verify the document was attached and re-run.

## Required structure (in this exact order)

# Export to Banner Reference Summary: <award_number>

> **Input precedence:** the award document governs; any sponsor
> terms & conditions provided fill gaps and are overridden by
> the award on any conflict.

### SECTION 1: AWARD IDENTIFICATION & CLASSIFICATION

- **Full Project Title:** <project_title>
- **Principal Investigator:** <pi_name>
- **Agency / Sponsor(s):** <sponsor_name>; list every entry in
  all_sponsors as "<name> (<role>)" when more than one
- **Award Type:** <award_type> — _Determination: <award_type_rationale>_ _(source: ...)_
- **Award Category:** <award_category_label> (Code `<award_category_code>`) — _Determination: <award_category_rationale>_ _(source: ...)_
- **Prime Sponsor Award ID:** <prime_sponsor_award_id or "Not specified">
- **Subrecipients:** <"Yes" / "No" from subrecipients_present>;
  when Yes, list each subrecipients entry as "<name> — <amount>"
- **Award Number / FAIN:** <award_number>
- **Assistance Listing / CFDA:** <cfda_number>; when
  additional_cfda_numbers non-empty, append "plus <list>"
- **NAICS Code:** <naics_code or "Not specified">
- **Action Type:** <action_type or "Not specified">
- **Federal Awarding Agency:** <federal_agency_name or "Not specified">
- **Pass-Through Status:** <"Direct Award" if !is_pass_through
  else "Pass-Through from " + prime_sponsor_name>

---

### SECTION 2: DATES & PERFORMANCE PERIOD

| Date Range | Start | End |
|---|---|---|

One row per all_date_ranges entry (label, start, end). If

### FINAL VERIFICATION CHECKLIST

- [ ] Award Type / Category / Indirect Basis / Billing Type are DETERMINATIONS (rationale shown), not copied labels

- [ ] All monetary amounts exact (no rounding); dates in original format
- [ ] FOATEXT lines cite valid line numbers with source locations
- [ ] Personnel, Subrecipients Y/N, Program Income Y/N, SF-270 Y/N all present
- [ ] Award number matches across all sections
- [ ] No discrepancies remain unflagged

## Rendering rules
- Bold every label. Reference document — concise and actionable.
- Preserve monetary and date formats verbatim.
- Render provenance per the PROVENANCE rules above.
- If any field arrives as a nested JSON object, REWRITE into
  prose / table — never pass through `{...}` literals.
- No JSON code fences around the output.

validation_plan.name: All deliverable sections rendered
validation_plan.description: Verify the deliverable renders every required section in order: Award Identification & Classification, Dates & Performance Period, Personnel, Budget & Financial, Billing & Payment, Reporting & Compliance, FOATEXT Line Items, Special Terms, and the Final Verification Checklist. Sections with no data must still render with their empty-state language rather than being dropped.

validation_plan.name: Award Type is a determination, not a copied label
validation_plan.description: Verify award_type is one of Grant, Cooperative Agreement, Contract, Letter Award, Gift Funding, or Purchase Order, and that it is accompanied by a determination rationale grounded in the project's attributes (substantial involvement, procurement vs. assistance, deliverables to the government, gift/PO instrument), NOT merely the word the sponsor used. Same expectation for Award Category, Indirect Cost Basis, and Billing Type.

validation_plan.name: Award-over-T&C precedence honored
validation_plan.description: When any sponsor terms & conditions are provided and conflict with the award document, verify the deliverable uses the AWARD document's value and flags the conflict, rather than silently using the T&C value.

validation_plan.name: All date / sponsor / amount variants captured
validation_plan.description: When the award mentions more than one date range, more than one sponsor, or more than one awarded amount, verify the deliverable lists them all (all_date_ranges, all_sponsors, all_award_amounts) rather than collapsing to a single value.

validation_plan.name: FOATEXT line items map to the catalog with source
validation_plan.description: Verify every FOATEXT Line Items row references a valid line number from the 100-230 catalog, carries award-specific text to paste into Banner FOATEXT, and cites where in the input document the term was found. Standard terms NOT present in the award must be omitted (no empty line rows).

validation_plan.name: Extracted values cite their source
validation_plan.description: Verify extracted values cite where in the input documents they were found (document + page/section, and a short snippet), at minimum for the determination fields (Award Type, Category, Indirect Basis, Billing Type), the funding amounts, and the FOATEXT line items.

validation_plan.name: Monetary amounts verbatim
validation_plan.description: Verify monetary amounts preserve the source document's currency formatting verbatim (no rounding, no added/removed separators or cents).

validation_plan.name: Personnel and Y/N flags present
validation_plan.description: Verify Co-PI/Co-I/Co-PD names, Senior/Key Personnel names, the Subrecipients Y/N flag, the Program Income Y/N flag plus amount, and the SF-270 Required Y/N flag are each rendered (with their empty-state language when the award is silent), not omitted.
